meta_description: Connected Products & Smart Devices from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: Where most programs improvise, connected products & smart devices as we deliver it is sequenced: Your product becomes a service — device fleets, OTA and telemetry products with revenue attached. The sequence matters more than the stack — both are documented here.

Connected products turn equipment vendors into service businesses — but only with fleet-grade engineering: secure provisioning and identity per device, OTA update infrastructure with staged rollout and rollback, telemetry pipelines into your data platform, and the product layer — usage analytics, predictive service, customer portals, usage-based billing. We build the device-to-revenue stack with security designed in: hardware roots of trust, signed firmware, vulnerability-management SLAs and disclosure processes aligned to cyber-resilience regulation (EU Cyber Resilience Act).

The commercial side is engineered with the technical: service-product design (uptime guarantees, consumables models, outcome contracts), pricing instrumentation from telemetry, and CRM/ERP integration so a sensor reading becomes a service ticket or a billing line. Clients launch connected service lines with real margin instead of free telematics portals that only cost money.

Connected Products & Smart Devices delivery today concentrates in Manufacturing & Industrial, Retail & Consumer Goods, Energy & Utilities, Healthcare & Life Sciences. The metric is chosen with your finance lead, and the baseline is signed before any build begins.
What ships, in the order it ships:

items: Device fleet platform
provisioning, identity, OTA with staged rollout and rollback
Fleet security
hardware roots of trust, signed firmware, EU CRA-aligned processes
Telemetry productization
usage analytics, predictive service and customer portals
Commercial instrumentation
usage-based billing hooks and CRM/ERP integration
Service design
uptime guarantees, consumables and outcome-based offerings
